convertibility_reason: Uses built-in iMA indicator only. Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed or percentage-based position sizing via CMoney management class (standard MQL5). No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. No grid, martingale, or complex pending order management.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (reverse on signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMType negative=fixed lots, positive=risk percent of free margin; CMoney class calculates lot size based on SL distance and risk percentage

custom_logic_notes: EA uses the standard CMoney class from MQL5 Standard Library for position sizing. When a reverse signal is detected, the EA closes the existing opposite position first, then opens a new position in the signal direction. SL/TP/Trailing values are adjusted by factor of 10 for 5-digit brokers (_Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). Trailing stop of 0 means trailing is disabled. The EA processes signals only on new bar formation using IsNewBar() check.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Two EMAs with crossover logic. Must implement digit adjustment for SL/TP (multiply by 10 for 5-digit). CMoney logic: if MMType<0 use fixed lots, if MMType>0 calculate lots = risk_percent * free_margin / (SL_pips * point_value * contract_size). New bar guard required - only evaluate signals at bar close. Reverse signal closes opposite position before entry.
